title: Hilton, 4-time Pro Bowl receiver with Colts, retires

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Hilton, 4-time Pro Bowl receiver with Colts, retires
sources.description: T.Y. Hilton, a four-time Pro Bowl wide receiver in his 10 seasons with the Colts, officially announced his retirement after last playing for the Cowboys in 2022.
